signals_info.description: Whether effective traction is lost; 0 means effective traction is available.

time_info.description: Bounded traction-state satisfaction window including the current time.

nl_Literal_translation_en: At some time from now through the next 3 seconds, traction loss shall equal 0.
nl_Literal_translation_zh: 从当前起至接下来的 3 秒内，牵引力丧失状态应至少有一个时刻为 0。
nl_Paraphrase_en: Within the 3-second window including now, the vehicle shall have effective traction at least once.
nl_Paraphrase_zh: 在包含当前时刻的 3 秒窗口内，车辆应至少有一个时刻具备有效牵引力。
